notes.title: Boxing School 2 is OUT!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!  
We proudly present Boxing School 2 to the world. Get ready to fight. It is time to become king in the ring. The long-awaited sequel to Boxing School is finally out and now available on Steam!

[previewyoutube=GlCHdWMSSaU;full][/previewyoutube]
DEVELOPMENT HISTORY
When we as a 2-man team started working on the first Boxing School 8 years ago we could never have imagined the massive response it would get. It has been truly rewarding to see so many people playing and enjoying the game through the years. And it has been challenging to plan and develop the sequel in a way that maintains the feeling and soul of Boxing School.

This time we are a 3-man team that has great ambition with this successor. We want Boxing School 2 to be the best boxing tycoon management game out there. And we work very hard with alot of passion to make that happen. Let just say that we have the same "Eye of the tiger" attitude and look on our faces that our handdrawn boxers in the game has. It has not been easy but we are proud over the result.

Thank you to everyone for your support. We hope you'll enjoy the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2627410/Boxing_School_2/

Special bundle offer for all of you
For all our past supporters that already own the first game, this special bundle allows you to get Boxing School 2 at a special discount.
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/52553/

Special message to all our most dedicated followers.
HELP US GAIN SOME MOMENTUM
We are not a AAA publisher with endless resources and huge budgets. We are just 3 guys in a basement that loves making games and truth be told can barely afford to hire a translator. We have to fight for every inch to have a chance.

If you want to be a big help to us please consider leaving a review on Steam. Reviews are incredibly important for indie games, especially during the first week of launch, and they help us get more visibility and momentum so the game can get off the ground abit. 

If you do, you’ll have our eternal gratitude. You can make a huge difference.

/From the guys making this game

notes.title: Announcing Boxing School 2
notes.content:
In celebration to a huge milestone that Boxing School has gathered 500 positive reviews on Steam we proudly present our next game. It is time to announce Boxing School 2. Train hard, fight hard and win! Created by exactly the same 3 guys that made Boxing School back in 2019. Follow and wishlist to keep track on upcoming release date. Thanks for your support!

WISHLIST NOW!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2627410/Boxing_School_2/

New improved combat!
The special combat from Boxing School returns, but refined and improved. Manage your fighters with 
the new "ringside" system between rounds that makes decisions impactful while adding more depth of 
play. All fights now have more drama and action.

New improved punching and blocking mechanics!
In Boxing School 2 there is new improved punching and blocking mechanics for fights that makes all styles more balanced.

New approach to gym development!
Build your own gym from the ground up and manage your roster. The management from Boxing School is back but with improvements to training, gym development tree, business office and support staff specialists.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33633853/892bc3007fd39ff4d1f4a64ad98883eb7312680a.jpg
New story campaign!
In Boxing School 2 you will meet 5 new characters in the story campaign with meaningful choices that 
will affect gameplay in a new way,

Expanded talent trees!
Just like in the previous Boxing School your boxers have unique fighting styles and skills. These 4 
styles has been improved and now has expanded talent trees. Do you want to teach non-stop swarmer 
aggression or a slower boxer style with more punching power? Or maybe you just want your boxer to be able to counter-attack and prey on opponent's mistakes. 

Build your legacy!
In Boxing School 2 there is now more choices with building your own brand. Make a name for your boxer. Build your reputation. Pick your nickname and theme-song as intro before fights. Pick your colors on your gear. Stand out among your rivals. Become famous in the boxing world.

Corner tactics and strategy!
In Boxing School 2 we introduce a new "ringside" coaching system with more depth to the tactical management between rounds. Manage your fighters between rounds to gain the edge on your rivals in the ring. Do you want your boxer to go for early KO and risk to run out of gas or play it more safe and wait for the right moment to strike when the opponent is tired? 

New grand 80s soundtracks!
Play that cut to dust on the radio, those sweet sweet tunes of the 80s while training your way to victory. Get ready for some banger soundtracks on the radio in the gym.

New boxing world event system!
Keep track of rankings, major boxing events, rivals and opponents in your world.

And much more...

notes.title: New release date for Boxing School DLC
notes.content:
Today we announce a new release date for the Solo Career Mode DLC. In celebration of FIVE YEAR ANNIVERSARY for Boxing School the new release date will be moved to 10th January 2024.

Message from the dev team
"This expansion DLC turned out to be better then we expected. Boxing school as a single boxer standalone campaign have great potential. We realize that we have a good opportunity here to release something very special in the "Boxing career RPG story theme". We have decided to delay the release a month and give it our best to add alot more content, extra polish and playtesting before we release. Thanks for your patience and support."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33633853/ff3042d85372ebeefa587ce9bfab6a8f0864f62b.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33633853/b9424a1ed2a291dc8456f57348414d8a07e2bbe5.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33633853/8afa3ff7b53f2efe613fe3246ce28e04853a43df.jpg

Boxing School : Solo Career Mode DLC 
New Release date: 10th January 2024 on Steam

Step into the shoes of a rookie boxer trying to survive. You'll be juggling your training, work, recreational time, and possible stardom. Play your own career story from beginner to star. With great struggle comes great rewards.

Be a part of the rivalry
This expansion offers new gameplay with more detailed and in-depth rivalry system. All top contenders now have unique personality types that always seek to win out over their greatest threats, sparking drama and rivalry in the top around the champion belt.

Choose your manager
Now you are the boxer and you will choose your own manager along the way. All managers have different sets of skills, talents and ambitions. Remember that a manager will have great impact on your career. Choose wisely.

Upgrade your own house
How will you spend your earnings outside the ring? Can you afford to upgrade your house or your gym equipment? Maybe take a vacation to relax between fights? Or maybe you can buy that new sports car that you always have been dreaming about if you win the next big fight.

Key Features:

Create your own boxer and play a new expanded career story mode.
Hire a manager or a promoter to arrange fights and sign deals.
Buy, upgrade and manage your own house and gym equipment.
Choose your strategy in fights, adjust your tactics between rounds.
Become famous and gain worldwide fans or even fanclubs.
Earn the right to challenge the champion himself for the title belt.
New story generator for Solo RPG boxing career
New competition ranking system
New world events and rivalry system
New fresh music tracks composed for this DLC

Wishlist today!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2543230/Boxing_School__Solo_Career_Mode/

notes.title: Announcing new expansion: Ready to Rumble
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33633853/ad3b536023b528938fbb17005460a31d8cd1ef28.png

Boxing School: Ready to Rumble is the next full DLC expansion for the ultimate boxing tycoon management game on Steam. 
This expansion adds a new gamemode and new features such as tournaments, press conference, boxing promoters, manager office, gym upgrades, 80s movie contracts, VIP sponsordeals, staff leveling, staff reputation, gymshop equipment, soda machine and much more. This DLC expansion will be free content together with the version 1.16 update to the basegame.

TOURNAMENTS
There is a new Boxing Competition Authority called "FightCorp" in town that hosts boxing tournaments. Keep an eye out for invitations to these rare events. Only the rich and famous people in town will be spectating and placing huge bets on these special fights in the gambling halls. Dominate the brackets to earn extra cash and fame. Qualify for the playoff rounds to get special rewards.

BOXING PROMOTERS
This has been by popular demand one of the most requested things by the community that we should add to Boxing School. Hire your own boxing promoters inhouse to manage and arrange several big fights at once. Or maximize the benefits of assigning several staff to promote one big fight to sell more tickets. Level up your promoters skill and experience to increase promotion effectiveness. Hire cheap promoters with obscure reputation or famous expensive legendary promoters with the most influence in the entire Boxing World.

PRESS CONFERENCE
All big major fights now have a press conference 2 days before the main event to promote the fight to the max. Both boxers and their managers will attend on stage in front of sports media. "Audience reach" and total coverage score is based on current hype rating for the fight. Newsreporters will be asking all the hard questions. The outcome of this event will affect hype meter and morale/fit for fight rating for both boxers on stage. You will decide how to approach these important events. You will select the answers to all questions. Be prepared!

NEW GYM EQUIPMENT
Get your own glorious "POWERHOUSE GEAR" that will bring major advantages to training or a "PUNCHMASTER DELUXE MACHINE" with the latest 80s technology to measure punching power and make sure that your boxer is fit for fight before the big day. The gymshop will also be updated with new top of the line upgrades to all existing training equipment. The best equipment is now superior and will no longer require repairs.

VIP SPONSORDEALS and 80s MOVIE CONTRACTS
Sign "deals of a lifetime" agreements for your boxers with movie studios or other big brands. What if they want your champion to become the star in a 80s action movie? Or attend the biggest promotional event for sports cars in the capital city. Negotiate huge paychecks. The sky is the limit for the World Champion!

MANAGER OFFICE
Welcome to your office in your own gym. Finally you can have your own desk. This expansion adds gym upgrades to the building itself but also to your office. Expand and upgrade.

SODA MACHINE
Are your boxers thirsty all the time? Well, not anymore. The Soda Machine "BEASTMASTER 3A45" is here. It has many different kinds of drinks and can be upgraded 5 times to absolute perfection levels of Soda Machinery. This new expensive addition to the shop is a must have for all gym owners. Can you afford it?

QUALITY OF LIFE - UPDATE 1.16
This is a MAJOR update for Boxing School that adds tons of improvements, fixes and UI refinements to the basegame.

Launch date to be announced soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/939990/Boxing_School/

We proudly present a brand new management game. Enjoy!

Key Features:
 
    Hire boxers and manage their career from beginner to star.
     Discover 4 different classes with unique fighting styles and skills.
     Customize your boxers outfit, nickname and branding.
     Arrange fights, promotional events and sign sponsorship deals.
     Scout new candidates with active potential rating system.

     Buy, upgrade and manage gym equipment.
